description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址池ID，地址池的唯一识别码。
description.en: The unique ID of the address pool.

description.zh: 地址池名称，方便用户区分地址池的用途。
description.en: The name of the address pool.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this token to make sure that each request is unique. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
地址池健康状态判定条件：

- any_ok：地址池内至少1个地址是可用地址。

- p30_ok：地址池内至少30%地址是可用地址。

- p50_ok：地址池内至少50%地址是可用地址。

- p70_ok：地址池内至少70%地址是可用地址。

- all_ok：地址池内地址全部可用。
description.en:
The condition for determining the health status of the address pool.

- any\_ok: At least one address in the address pool is active.

- p30\_ok: At least 30% of the addresses in the address pool are active.

- p50\_ok: At least 50% of the addresses in the address pool are active.

- p70\_ok: At least 70% of the addresses in the address pool are active.

- all\_ok: All addresses in the address pool are active.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-pool-basic-config --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-pool-id pool-895280232254420000 --address-pool-name app --health-judgement any_ok --region cn-hangzhou
